rules: A visible page or button is not complete unless it invokes an authoritative API/runtime and renders the returned outcome.
Read-only observation must never be described as execution or authorization.
No mock data may be presented as production state.
Existing engines, identity, evidence, release gates, and platform boundaries remain authoritative.
Unknown capabilities remain UNKNOWN until verified.

capabilities.detail: Reads live health, jobs, agents, and job evidence; cloud worker is explicitly shown as not deployed.
capabilities.acceptance: Retain live API and no-demo-data behavior; add interaction tests.

capabilities.detail: Calls /v1/ai/generate and supports wide/normal layout; chat state is in-memory only and no model/agent/plugin selector is present.
capabilities.acceptance: Durable conversation history, provider/model selection, explicit agent/workflow routing, and real error/stream behavior.

capabilities.detail: Navigation points to the static Platform Directory; no live project/file workspace is rendered.
capabilities.acceptance: Connect only to existing project/workspace/file APIs; support real inspect/open actions and explicit unsupported states.

capabilities.detail: Navigation currently selects the static Platform Directory rather than a history/activity view.
capabilities.acceptance: Render authenticated jobs, orchestration timeline, and evidence from their authoritative APIs.

capabilities.detail: Sign-in/sign-out and provider discovery exist; Settings & Account navigation is a directory placeholder.
capabilities.acceptance: Expose only existing account/provider settings with server-side authorization and clear unsupported states.

capabilities.detail: OWNER-only management inventory and audit reads are wired; UI explicitly states inventory is read-only.
capabilities.acceptance: Keep read-only until durable lifecycle, credential, approval, audit, and recovery contracts are proven; then add individually authorized operations.

capabilities.detail: Reads ProjectRegistry metadata and renders project details; no project mutation/open-file operations in this page.
capabilities.acceptance: Add supported project actions only after confirming authoritative API contracts.

capabilities.detail: Page reads orchestration runs and timelines; client has create/execute/confirm/retry/cancel methods not exposed by this page.
capabilities.acceptance: Expose prepare/create and approved lifecycle actions with server authorization, confirmation, audit, and E2E tests.

capabilities.detail: Local conversation persistence and optional cloud conversation sync exist; provider/model/agent/plugin capability coverage requires separate verification.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify real send path, provider/model routing, cross-device sync behavior, and failure recovery.

capabilities.detail: Runtime observations are API-backed; command actions include local navigation and local simulation toggles, while audit snapshots are locally assembled. The pure control kernel delegates I/O to adapters.
capabilities.acceptance: Bind each command to an existing authoritative executor or label it prepare/inspect only; persist audit evidence through canonical evidence services.

capabilities.detail: Server-derived owner identity and health/projects/workflows/agents/providers observations are displayed; page is intentionally read-only.
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve authority boundary; only add actions backed by owner-authorized server workflows.

capabilities.detail: A V3 runtime PluginRegistry exists, but no user-facing plugin catalog/install/connect/permission/test/enable/disable/audit service or API was found in the inspected repository paths.
capabilities.acceptance: Design and implement a server-owned plugin manifest/connection/secret/permission/audit lifecycle; never treat runtime handler registration as marketplace installation.

capabilities.detail: OWNER-authenticated metadata CRUD/lifecycle exists with JSON persistence and separate API-key lifecycle; usage/cost are empty runtime-ledger projections.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify production persistence, credential secrecy, audit atomicity, approval and runtime-ledger integration before exposing mutations.

capabilities.detail: Dedicated Control Center workflow currently filters web/API paths; Flutter control/owner tests are not included by its path trigger.
capabilities.acceptance: Add Flutter path triggers and run relevant Flutter analyze/widget tests in the Control Center gate.
